tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i gsung las byung ba'i rnam bshad rgyud bzhi mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs// mod rgyud zab mo'i de nyid legs rtogs pas/ /'bum phrag gzhung la mgrin pa'i dbang 'byor zhing / /blo gsal yongs la dga' ston 'gyed mdzad pa'i/ /kho bos 'dren mchog klu sgrub rgya mtsho rgyal/ /zhes mchod nas/ las su bya ba ji lta bu zhe na/ las su bya ba ni/ bstan bcos sdom pa gsum gyi rab dbye'i don gsal bar byed pa'i rnam bshad rgyud bzhi mdzes rgyan/ zhes bya ba 'di nyid 'chad la/ 'di yang mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan khri tshang pa chen po mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i gsung las dngos su thob pa/ kho bo shākya'i btsun pa brtson 'grus kyi rtsom pa cher mi ldan kyang / shes rab kyi zegs ma mtshon tsam dang / dad pa'i shugs cung zad dang ldan pa'i rin sdings pa nam mkha' rnam rgyal bdag gis zin bris su bkod nas brjod na gnyis te/ lus mdor bstan dang / yan lag rgyas bshad do/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ brjod bya byed las ldan pa'i mtshan don bkod pa/ dgos pa gsum ldan bla ma mchod pa/ dgos pa gsum ldan khas len dam bca' bshad pa/ dgos pa gsum ldan lus kyi gtso bo bsdu ba'o/ /dang po 'chad pa la/ gang bshad par bya ba'i bstan bcos 'di la sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba zhes 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba sdom pa gsum ma thob pa thob par byed pa'i cho ga'i rnam gzhag de mi nyams par srung ba'i bslab bya'i rnam gzhag nyams na phyir bcos pa'i tshul/ sdom pa gsum po de dag ma dag gi rab dbye rnams phyin ci ma log pa ston par byed pas na/ de ltar du bzhag pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa la/ sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba zhes bya ba zhes pa 'di byung / gnyis pa la gsum ste/ bla ma mchod tshul dngos/ mchod yul dam pa'i yon tan bsdus te bstan pa/ mchod nas dam pa'i las la 'jug par gdams pa'o/

/dang po 'chad pa la/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta bdag gis bstan bcos sdom gsum rab dbye rtsom pa'i thog mar rtsa ba'i bla ma grags pa rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal ba chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ bstan bcos 'di rtsom pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi zhing / mthun skyen bsod nams 'phel nas rtsom mthar phyin par bya ba'i ched yod pa'i phyir zhes 'chad pa la/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa 'di byung / gnyis pa 'chad pa la/ 'o na sa paṇa khyod la rtsa ba'i bla ma du ma yod pa yod pa las/ grags pa rgyal mtshan kho na la phyag byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ de'i rgyu mtshan yod de rtsa ba'i bla ma grags pa rgyal mtshan de bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i lung dang rigs pa'i seng ge'i nga ro'i sgras lta ba ngan pa la gnas pa'i rgol ba ri dwags kyi tshogs mtha' dag skrag par mdzad pa log smra tshar gcod pa'i yon tan dang / sdom pa gsum gyi nyams len sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du sgrub nus pa'i skal ldan rjes su 'dzin pa'i yon tan gnyis la sogs pa gzhan dang mtshungs pa med pa'i yon tan mnga' ba'i bla ma dam pa de yin pas na/ rje btsun grags pa kho na la phyag 'tshal ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa la/ bde gshegs bstan pa'i gsung rab seng ge'i sgras/ /lta ngan ri dwags mtha' dag skrag par mdzad/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pa ji bzhin legs sgrub pa/ /mtshungs med bla ma de la bdag cag dad/ /ces pa 'di byung / gsum pa de 'chad pa la/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta khyod sku gsung thugs la nyes pa'i skyon med cing / spang rtogs yon tan gyi mdzod mnga' ba'i 'gro ba'i bla ma grags pa rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal nas/ las su bya ba gang zhe na/ las su bya ba byed pa'i tshul yod de/ las su bya ba bstan bcos sdom gsum 'di rtsom mo zhes shes par bya ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa la/ skyon med yon tan kun gyi mdzod mnga' ba/

/'gro ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /zhes pa 'di byung / gsum pa khas len dam bca' 'chad pa la gsum ste/ 'chad pa'i yul la bshad bya 'chad tshul dngos/ sbyor ba phun tshogs go bde'i tshig gis bshad/ bsam pa phun tshogs lhag bsam dag pas bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po 'chad pa la/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta khyod bstan bcos sdom gsum rab dbye 'di rtsom pa'am/ 'chad pa yin na/ 'chad yul gyi gdul bya su zhig la 'chad ce na/ de 'chad yul gyi gdul bya yod de/ sangs rgyas bstan pa la dad pa gsum dang ldan zhing / bstan pa'i rtsa ba sdom pa gsum gyi nyams len sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin sgrub par 'dod kyang / rang stobs kyis sgrub ma nus pa'i gdul bya de la 'chad pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa la/ dad ldan sangs rgyas gsung bzhin sgrub 'dod pa/ /de la sdom gsum dbye ba bdag gis bshad/ /zhes pa 'di byung / gnyis pa 'chad pa la/ 'o na sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta khyod bstan bcos 'di de la 'chad pa yin na/ tshig gi sbyor ba gang gi sgo nas 'chad pa yin zhe na/ go bde ba'i sgo nas 'chad tshul yod de/ sdeb sbyor dam pos tshig gis bcings pa'i sbyor ba rnams spangs shing / go bde ba'i ngag gi sgo nas 'chad pa'am bshad pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta bdag gis bstan bcos sdom gsum rab dbye 'di go bde ba'i ngag gis bshad pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ bod kyi gdul bya mkhas rmongs kun gyis go bar bya ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir te/ rgya gar mkhas pa rnams dga' ba'i me tog phreng 'dzin la sogs pa'i yi ge lci yang gi sdeb sbyor gyis bcings shing / don rgyan sgra rgyan gab tshig gi rgyan rnams dang / 'chi med mdzod la sogs pa'i mngon brjod kyis spras pa'i sdeb sbyor dam po rnams bod kyi gdul bya blun po rnams kyis go dka' ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa la/ mkhas rnams dga' ba'i sdeb sbyor ni/

/blun po rnams kyis go dka' bas/ /tshig gi sbyor ba spangs nas kyang / /kun gyis go bar bya phyir bshad/ /zhes pa 'di byung / gsum pa 'chad pa la sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta khyod bstan bcos 'di rtsom pa yin na/ dgos pa ci'i phyir gzhan la 'gran sems dang / phrag dog gi sgo nas rtsom pa yin nam zhe na/ de 'dra ni ma yin te/ sa paṇa bdag ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / de 'dzin pa'i skyes bu la dad pa brtan po dang ldan pa de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang bdag la bstan bcos 'di rtsom pa'i kun slong yod de/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'khrul par spyod pa'i gang zag rnams la ma dad pa ste/ snying rje'i kun nas blangs te rtsom pa yin pa'i phyir zhes 'chad pa la/ bdag ni sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /mi phyed pa yi dad pa yod/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /'khrul par spyod la bdag ma dad/ /zhes pa 'di byung / bzhi pa dgos pa gsum ldan lus gtso bsdu ba la/ 'o na sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta khyod chos dang chos ma yin pa rnam par 'byed pa'i bstan bcos sdom gsum 'di rtsom pa yin na/ rtsom tshul ji ltar byed ce na/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chos can/ khyod kyi bstan bcos 'di rtsom pa'i tshul yod de/ 'dul ba'i sde snod kyi brjod bya so sor thar pa'i sdom pa/ mdo sde'i sde snod kyi brjod bya'i gtso bo byang sdom/ rgyud sde'i brjod bya'i gtso bo sngags sdom dang gsum po de/ ma thob pa thob par byed pa cho ga'i rnam gzhag thob pa mi nyams par bsrung ba so so'i bslab bya/ sems bskyed pa'i gnad bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems/ theg pa chen po'i lam gyi gtso bo stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi byang chub kyi sems/ gsang sngags kyi lam gyi gnad rim pa gnyis kyi gsang tshig de'i lam gyi gtso bo ye shes phyag rgya chen po/ de'i lam gyi khyad chos phyi nang gsang gsum gyis bsdus pa'i rten 'brel/

de'i sa lam gyi rnam gzhag rnams la dag ma dag gi rnam gzhag phyin ci ma log par gsal bar ston pa'i sgo nas rtsom pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de na bstan bcos 'di'i thog mar lus bsdus te bstan pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ 'chad pa po 'chad sla ba dang / nyan pa po gzung bde zhing / bstan bcos la nges pa bskyed pa ste dgos pa gsum yod pa'i phyir te/ mkhas pa 'jug sgo las/ 'chad sla ba dang gzung bde zhing / /bstan bcos la yang rtsod bral phyir/ /mkhas pa la la bstan bcos lus/ /bsdus te thog mar 'god par byed/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes 'chad pa la/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed dang / /gsang sngags kyi ni dbang bskur dang / /de dag gi ni cho ga dang / /so so'i bslab par bya ba dang / /sems bskyed pa yi gnad rnams dang / /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po dang / /rim pa gnyis kyi gsang tshig dang / /ye shes phyag rgya chen po dang / /phyi dang nang gi rten 'brel dang / /sa dang lam gyi rnam gzhag gi /rnam par dbye ba bshad kyis nyon/ /zhes pa 'di byung / des lus mdor bstan la sogs pa'i gzhung rnams la tshig 'bru hrug tsam cig bsdus te bstan nas/ gnyis pa yan lag rgyas bshad la gsum ste/ so sor thar pa nyan thos 'dul ba nas bshad pa bzhin nyams su len tshul ston pa'i skabs dang po bshad pa/ byang sdom mdo sde nas bshad pa bzhin nyams su len tshul ston pa'i skabs gnyis pa bshad pa/ sngags sdom rgyud sde nas bshad pa bzhin nyams su len tshul ston pa'i skabs gsum pa bshad pa'o/ /de la da lam dang po gnyis btang snyoms su bzhag nas/ gsum pa de nyid 'chad rgyu yin pas/ de la gnyis te/ gzhung gi 'grel dang / dka' gnas kyis mtha' dpyad zab mo bstan pa'o/ /dang po la smin byed dbang gi gnad la 'khrul pa dgag pa/ grol byed kyi lam la 'khrul pa dgag pa/ ye shes phyag chen gyi 'khrul pa dgag pa/

yan lag lta ba'i 'khrul pa dgag pa/ rgyud sde'i sgrub thabs kyi 'khrul pa dgag pa/ bogs 'byin spyod pa'i 'khrul pa dgag pa/ mthar thug 'bras bu'i 'khrul pa dgag pa/ gnas skabs sa lam gyi gnad la 'khrul pa dgag pa dang brgyad yod pa'i/ brgyad pa 'chad pa la/ lam la nyams dang go ba dang / /rtogs pa zhes bya rnam pa gsum/ /zhes sogs kyis 'chad/ bdun pa/ la la stong nyid sgom pa las/ /'bras bu sku gsum 'dod pa dang / /zhes sogs kyis 'chad/ drug pa/ dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa dang / /zhes sogs kyis 'chad/ lnga pa/ rgyud sde bzhi yi sgrub pa yang / /zhes sogs kyis 'chad/ bzhi pa/ la la theg pa rim dgu sogs kyis 'chad/ gsum pa/ phyag rgya chen po sgom na yang / /zhes sogs kyis 'chad/ gnyis pa la/ kha cig 'khrul dang ma 'khrul med/ /zhes sogs kyis 'chad/ dang po 'chad pa la gsum ste/ ma 'khrul ba'i smin byed ngos bzung ba/ 'khrul pa'i smin byed 'gog tshul/ zhar byung dbang gi dam tshig la 'khrul pa dgag pa'o/ /dang po 'chad pa la/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam zhugs te/ /zhes sogs 'byung ba yin pas/ 'di nyid la tshig 'bru cung zad cig bshad na/ bla med rdo rje theg pa'i lam du zhugs te/ myur du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i gang zag de chos can/ khyod kyis smin byed kyi dbang bzhi dang / grol byed kyi lam rim pa gnyis po de la 'bad dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de gnyis ni khyod myur du 'tshang rgya bar byed pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin te/ rab tshe 'di/ 'bring bar do/ tha na yang skye ba phyi ma'am/ skye ba bdun nam/ skye ba bcu drug tshun chad du 'tshang rgya ba'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro zhes 'chad pa la/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam zhugs te/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob 'dod na/ /smin grol gnyis la 'bad par bya/ /zhes pa 'di byung / smin byed dbang bzhi dang / grol byed kyi lam rim pa gnyis po de la 'bad pas/ rab tshe 'di/

'bring bar do la sogs pa de rnams su 'tshang rgya ba'i shes byed kyi lung yod pa yin te/ rim bzhin/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ 'di yi chos kyi bdag nyid che/ /sku gsum mi phyed las byung ba/ /ye shes rgya mtshos rnam par rgyan/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /ces dang / de nyid las/ yang na lus 'di spangs ma thag /brtson par mi ldan pas kyang 'grub/ /ces dang / gsang ba'i mdzod las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan pas/ /skye shing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de yi skye ba bdun dag nas/ /ma sgom par yang sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dam tshig lnga pa las/ gal te ltung ba med gyur na/ /skye ba bcu drug dag nas 'grub/ /zhes pa rnams gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /smin grol gnyis la 'bad pa la brten nas/ myur du sangs rgya ba yin na/ 'o na smin byed kyi dbang bzhi po de yul gang las len/ de blangs pa la dgos pa ci yod ce na/ shes bya chos can/ dbang bzhi po de blang ba'i yul yod de/ rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du snyan brgyud bzhi'i bar ma chad pa ste/ bla ma brgyud pa ma nyams pa/ dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rnams la lhag chad nor gsum gyi skyon dang bral ba ste/ cho ga 'khrugs par ma gyur pa/ rten slob ma la phyi nang gsang gsum gyis mtshon pa'i rten 'brel sgrig mkhyen pa/ rten slob ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhi la sku bzhi'i sa bon nus ldan du thebs nus pa yin pa/ mdor na dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rnams sangs rgyas kyis ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin mdzad pa'i bla ma dam pa cig btsal la de la dbang bzhi po de blang dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes 'chad pa la/ smin par byed pa'i dbang bskur yang / /bla ma brgyud pa ma nyams shing / /cho ga 'khrugs par ma gyur pa/ /phyi nang rten 'brel sgrig mkhyen cing / /sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs nus pa/ /sangs rgyas gsung bzhin mdzad pa yi/ /bla ma btsal la dbang bzhi blang /

/zhes pa 'di byung / de rnams rgyas par bshad na/ 'o na snyan brgyud bzhi bar ma chad pas/ bla ma brgyud pa ma nyams par 'gro ba yin na/ snyan brgyud bzhi po de ji lta bu zhe na/ de bzhi 'jog tshul yod de/ dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa/ byin brlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa/ gdams ngag gi sarga ma log pa/ mos gus kyi bsam pa tshim pa dang bcas pa'i bzhi po de la 'jog pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na de bzhi gang la 'jog pa yin zhe na/ de bzhi ngos 'dzin pa la/ dang po la gnyis te/ dbang gi chu bo ngos bzung ba dang / de ma nub pa'i tshad bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dbang gi ye shes rnams la dbang gi chu bo zhes 'jog pa yin te/ dper na chu des snod kyi dri ma rnams 'khrud par byed pa de bzhin du/ dbang gi ye shes des kyang slob ma'i sgo gsum gyi dri ma rnams 'khrud par byed pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ rgyu dus kyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa'i tshad/ lam dus kyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa'i tshad/ 'bras dus kyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa'i tshad bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyu dus kyi dbang gi ye shes rnams la rgyu dus kyi dbang gi chu bor 'jog cing / de ma nub pa'i tshad ni/ rgyu dus kyi dbang thob nas/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi po gang rung ma byung ba'i bar gyi dbang gi nyams len rnams la 'jog pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ thun mong ba dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i lam dus kyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa'i tshad bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ lam dbang thob nas zhag bdun gyi khongs su dbang don nyams su len pa'i nyams len dang ma bral ba cig la 'jog go /gnyis pa de 'jog tshul yod de/ lus dkyil du lam dbang thob nas/ rab thun bzhi/ 'bring thun gsum/ tha na yang thun gnyis ma chag par len pa'i nyams len de la 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa 'jog tshul yod de/ sa bcu gsum gyi phyed 'og ma'i dbang gi ye shes de la 'bras dus kyi dbang gi chu bo zhes 'jog cing /

sa bcu gsum pa'i phyed gong ma la mtshams sbyor bar byed pa'i phyed 'og ma'i dbang gi ye shes skyes shing gnas pa de la 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa'i tshad de ltar yin na/ 'o na byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa de la ci 'dra cig dgos she na/ de la yang khyad chos mtha' bzhi dang ldan pa cig dgos te/ nyams su len pa'i mtha'/ nyams su myong ba'i mtha'/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtha'/ grub pa'i mtha' ste gsang sngags mtha' bzhi dang bcas zhes pa lta bu cig dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhi yang 'jog tshul yod de/ bla mas bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim la sogs pa sgom tshul 'di ltar gyis gsungs pa'i nyams len bstan pa de nyid/ rang nyid kyis nyams su len pa de la/ nyams su len pa'i mtha' zhes 'jog de ltar nyams bskyangs pa la brten nas/ rang nyid kyi rgyud la bum dbang gi lta ba ngo bo nyid gsum/ gsang dbang gi lta ba rang byung gi ye shes bzhi la sogs pa skyes pa de la/ nyams su myong ba'i mtha' zhes 'jog de ltar skyes pa la brten nas/ phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro'i byin gyis brlabs pa de la/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtha' zhes 'jog de ltar byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas/ grub mtha' dang po 'khor 'das dbyer med/ grub mtha' gnyis pa ma 'dres la yongs su rdzogs pa/ grub mtha' gsum pa bde stong rgya chung ba/ grub mtha' bzhi pa bde stong rgya che ba la sogs pa snyogs pa de la grub pa'i mtha' zhes 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar yin na gdams ngag gis sarga ma log pa de gang la 'jog ce na/ 'dir 'ga' zhig gdams ngag gi sarga ma log pa zhes zer zhing / 'ga' zhig gdams ngag gi sar kha ma log pa zhes gsung ba rnams ni rtog pas btags pa tsam du zad do/ /des na 'di ni snyan ngag me long las/ sargas bcings pa snyan ngag che/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'di legs sbyar gyi skad yin pas/ gdams ngag gi sarga ma log pa zhes bya ba yin la/

de'i don yang phyin ci ma log pa'am/ go rim ma log pa'am/ sgra ji bzhin pa zhes pa'i don yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi thugs dbyings rdzogs par gyur cig des na gdams ngag gi sarga ma log pa de la'ang / khyad chos bzhi dang ldan pa cig dgos te/ bar chad ngo shes pas bdud kyi gegs sel ba/ ting nge 'dzin ngo shes pas bsam gtan gyi gegs sel ba/ skyon yon tan du slong shes pa/ bar chad dngos grub tu len shes pa ste/ khyad chos de rnams dang ldan pa cig dgos pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa mos gus kyi bsam pa tshim pa ni/ bla mas nyams len bstan cing / bstan pa de nyid rang nyid kyis nyams su blangs pa la brten nas/ rang nyid kyi rgyud la nyams myong tshad ma skyes/ de skyes pa la brten nas rang nyid kyi bla ma de la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes skyes te/ rkyen gzhan gyis 'phrog par mi nus pa'i bsam pa de la 'jog pa yin no/ /bla ma brgyud pa ma nyams pa la khyad chos de lta bu dgos na/ cho ga 'khrugs par ma gyur pa la khyad chos ji 'dra ba cig tshang dgos she na/ de la yang khyad chos bzhi ldan dgos te/ zhal dang 'dra ba'i cho ga'i sgo brgyad/ spyan dang 'dra ba'i cho ga'i gtso bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ phyag dang 'dra ba'i cho ga'i yan lag bcu drug zhabs dang 'dra ba'i cho ga'i chings bzhi ste/ de rnams dang ldan pa cig dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de rnams kyi yang dang po brgyad po de 'jog tshul yod de/ sngon du 'gro ba bsnyen pa'i cho ga slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi cho ga sa'i cho ga sta gon gyi/ bri zhing rgyan bgram pa/ sgrub cing mchod pa/ 'jug cing dbang blang ba/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i rjes kyi cho ga dang brgyad po de la 'jog pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dang po bsnyen pa la gsum ste/ rab mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa/ 'bring dus bsnyen/ tha ma grangs kyi bsnyen pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ rab yi dam lha'i zhal mthong ba/

'bring rdo rje dril bu nam mkha' la 'jog nus pa yin pa/ tha na nyams sam rmi lam du lung bstan pa cig dgos shing / de gsum kas gzhi bsnyen gyi go chod pa yin no/ /gnyis pa dus bsnyen la rab 'bring gsum du yod pa'i gsum po de la/ rje btsun bsod rtse'i rab lo drug 'bring zla ba drug tha ma zla ba gsum dgos so zhes gsungs la/ rje btsun grags pas/ rab zla ba drug 'bring la zla ba gsum/ tha ma la zhag bdun dgos shing / grangs bsnyen gyi rab la gtso bo la bzhi 'bum/ 'khor la bzhi khri/ 'bring gi gtso bo la bzhi khri/ 'khor la bzhi stong / tha ma'i gtso bo la bzhi stong / 'khor la bzhi brgya dgos la/ des na dus bsnyen dang grangs bsnyen gnyis kyi rab gnyis po des gzhi bsnyen gyi go chod cing / 'bring man chad kyis go mi chod do zhes gsungs la/ grangs bsnyen la sa skya pa chen po'i brtag gnyis bka' 'grel du/ de wa pi tsu la bzhi 'bum dang / rtsa sngags bzlas pa na 'bum phrag cig dgos pa yin no/ /zhes sogs rje btsun gong ma'i gsung de rnams las da lam 'dir rje grags pa'i gsung de tshad mar khas len pa yin no/ /gnyis pa gtso bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'jog tshul yod de/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos bcu/ dngos gzhi la slob ma'i dbang drug slob dpon gyi dbang bzhi ste bcu/ mthar rten la/ rjes gnang / lung bstan/ dbugs dbyung / gzengs bstod dang bzhi ste nyer bzhi po de la 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa yan lag bcu drug 'jog tshul yod de/ bsnyen pa bya ba/ sa'i cho ga la sa brtag pa/ sbyang ba/ blang ba/ sa bzung ba/ sa bsrung ba dang lnga/ sta gon la/ sa'i lha mo sta gon/ lha sta gon/ bum pa sta gon/ slob ma sta gon ste bzhi/ bri zhing rgyan pa bgram pa la/ bri ba la/ thig gis bri ba/ tshon gyis bri ba gnyis/ dang po la/ ye shes kyi thig gis bri ba dang / las kyi thig gis bris pa gnyis te/ bri ba la gsum/

rgyan bgram pa/ sgrub pa/ mchod pa dang bcas pa'i bcu drug po de la 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i rgyan de la yang sa rgyan dang / gnam rgyan gnyis yod pa'i dang po de ni/ rkyang nul bya ba zhes bya ba dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i gzhi der snum phyis sam/ ba byung lnga'i byug pa byed pa lta bu la 'jog pa yin la/ gnyis pa de ni/ bla re dang / 'phan la sogs pa la 'jog pa yin no/ /sgrub pa de la yang gsum yod de/ bdun bsres kyi sgrub pa/ lnga bsres kyi sgrub pa/ bzhi bsres kyi sgrub pa rnams yongs su yod pa'i phyir ro/ /mchod pa la yang / phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dang bzhi yod do/ /bzhi pa chings bzhi ni/ bum dbang / gsang dbang / sher dbang / dbang bzhi pa'i chings dang bzhi po de la 'jog go /zhes 'chad pa la/ cho ga 'khrugs par ma gyur pa/ /zhes pa dang / pha rol phyin gzhung mi nus par/ /gal te gsang sngags sgom 'dod na/ /nor pa med pa'i dbang bzhi long / /'khrul pa med pa'i rim gnyis sgom/ /zhes pa 'di rnams byung / smin byed dbang bzhi po de bskur bar byed pa'i rdo rje slob dpon des/ rten slob ma de la phyi nang gsang gsum gyis mtshon pa'i rten 'brel rnam pa lnga bsgrig pa'i tshul yod de/ phyi'i rten 'brel gtso bor yul gyi steng du sgrig nang gi rten 'brel de gtso bo de sems kyi steng du sgrig gsang ba'i rten 'brel gtso bor rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi steng du sgrig de kho na nyid kyi de gtso bor chos thams cad kyi steng du sgrig mthar thug gi de gtso bor spang bya dang gnyen po gnyis mthar thug pa'i gnas skabs der sgrig pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa lta bu sbyang gzhi phyi'i rten 'brel/ de la byang phyogs so bdun gyi dag pa sbyor ba de sbyong byed kyi phyi rten 'brel sgrub pa rang nyid kyi phung po lnga/

'byung ba lnga/ nyon mongs pa lnga/ skye mched bcu gnyis/ tshigs chen brgyad la sogs pa rnams sbyangs gzhi'i nang rten 'brel/ nang dkyil 'khor gyi lha gtso 'khor lnga dang / dgu dang / sum cu rtsa bdun la sogs pa rnams sbyong byed kyi nang rten 'brel yin zhing / rten 'brel de ltar bsgrigs pa la brten nas/ sgrub pa po rang nyid 'tshang rgya ba'i tshe/ sgrub pa po rang nyid/ rang nyid la byin gyis rlob pa'i bla ma cig rang dang rtogs pa mnyam pa'i mtshan ldan gyi rig ma cig rang nyid la dad pa thob pa'i slob ma cig rang nyid kyi bar chad sel nus pa'i chos srung dkar phyogs kyi lha cig dang bcas te 'khor tshom bu can cig tu 'tshang rgya ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa la/ phyi nang rten 'brel sgrig mkhyen cing / /zhes pa 'di byung / des na smin byed dbang bskur ba'i tshe dkyil 'khor gyi lha la ma mtha' lha gtso 'khor lnga tshang dgos pa'i gnad kyang de nyid yin no/ /phyi nang rten 'brel sgrig mkhyen cing / /zhes pa'i tshig zur gyi/ cing zhes pa'i nus pas/ de lta bus rdo rje slob dpon des/ rten slob ma de la rten 'brel rnam pa lnga po de sgrig par ma zad/ rten slob ma de'i dkyil 'khor bzhi la sku bzhi'i sa bon yang 'debs par byed pa yin te/ smin byed kyi dbang bzhi po de la brten nas 'debs par byed pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhi la brten nas/ rten slob ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhi la sku bzhi'i sa bon nus ldan du thebs par nus pa yin te/ smin byed bum dbang la brten nas lus rtsa la sangs rgyas sprul sku'i sa bon thebs par nus/ smin byed gsang dbang la brten nas rtsa yi ge la sangs rgyas longs sku'i sa bon thebs par nus/ smin byed sher dbang la brten nas khams bdud rtsi la sangs rgyas chos sku'i sa bon thebs par nus/ smin byed dbang bzhi pa la brten nas snying po ye shes rlung la sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid sku'i sa bon nus ldan du thebs par nus pa yin pa'i phyir/

zhes 'chad pa la/ sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs nus pa/ /zhes pa 'di byung / des na de lta bu'i slob ma de'i dbang bzhi po de len pa'i tshul yang yod de/ dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rnams sangs rgyas kyi rgyud sde nas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin byed pa'i bla ma dam pa cig btsal te/ de la dbang bzhi po de len pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa la/ bla ma btsal la dbang bzhi blang / /zhes pa 'di byung / de lta bu'i rdo rje slob dpon des/ slob ma de la dbang bzhi po bskur ba chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ dbang len par byed pa'i slob ma de sdom pa gsum ldan du bya ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa la/ de yi sdom pa gsum ldan 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de sdom pa gsum ldan du byed pa'i tshul yang yod de/ dbang gi sbyor ba'i gnas skabs su gtso bor so thar dang byang sdom gnyis thob par byed/ dngos gzhi bum dbang gi skabs su gtso bor bskyed rim gyi sdom pa thob par byed/ dbang gong ma gsum gyi gnas skabs su gtso bor rdzogs rim gyi sdom pa thob par byed pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar sdom pa gsum ldan du byas pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ gzhi sdom pa gsum la gnas nas lam rim pa gnyis po nyams su blang pa la brten nas/ mthar thug sa bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i ched yod pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa dge ba/ /bcu gsum pa ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsang sngags bla med kyi smin byed kyi dbang de la/ smin byed bum dbang la sogs pa bzhir yod cing / bzhi po der grangs nges pa yin na/ de bzhir grangs nges pa'i rgyu mtshan ji lta bu zhe na/ bla med kyi dbang la smin byed bum dbang la sogs pa bzhir grangs nges pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gang gis bskur bar byed pa'i rdo rje slob dpon de la bzhir grangs nges/

gang du bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor de la yang bzhir grangs nges/ gang la bskur ba'i rten slob ma'i dkyil 'khor de la'ang bzhir grangs nges/ sbyang bya'i dri ma de la'ang bzhir grangs nges/ de sbyong ba'i lam de la'ang bzhir grangs nges/ lam de bskyangs pa la brten nas skyes pa'i nyams myong gi lta ba de la'ang bzhir grangs nges/ de la brten nas sa thob pa'i grub mtha' de la'ang bzhir grangs nges/ 'da' kha ma'i gdams ngag la'ang bzhir grangs nges/ bar do'i gdams ngag la'ang bzhir grangs nges/ 'gros bzhi thim tshul la'ang bzhir grangs nges/ gnas gyur 'bras bu de la yang bzhir grangs nges pa'i phyir ro/ /dang po grub ste/ de la phyi sgro 'dogs dpyod par byed pa'i bla ma/ nang rang byung gi ye shes ston par byed pa'i bla ma/ gsang ba lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ston par byed pa'i bla ma/ mthar thug chos thams cad mthar thug de kho na nyid du ston par byed pa'i bla ma dang bzhir grangs nges pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa grub ste/ de la phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor/ phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor dang bzhir nges pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa de grub ste/ de la lus rtsa'i dkyil 'khor/ rtsa yi ge'i dkyil 'khor/ khams bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor/ snying po ye shes rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang bzhir nges pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa grub ste/ de la lus ngag yid gsum ka'i dri ma dang bzhir nges pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa grub ste/ de la bskyed pa'i rim pa dbyibs kyi lam/ gtum mo tsaṇ+ḍa li'i lam/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lam/ rdo rje rba rlabs kyi lam dang bzhir nges pa'i phyir ro/ /drug pa grub ste/ de la bum dbang gi lta ba ngo bo nyid gsum/ gsang dbang gi lta ba rang byung gi ye shes bzhi/ sher dbang gi lta ba yas bab kyi dga' ba bzhi/

dbang bzhi pa'i lta ba mas stan gyi dga' ba bzhi dang bcas pa'i bzhi po der nges pa'i phyir ro/ /de rnams kyi dang po ngo bo nyid gsum gyi 'jog tshul yod de/ snang phyogs kyi ting nge 'dzin/ stong phyogs kyi ting nge 'dzin/ zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin dang gsum po de la 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /rang byung bzhi 'jog tshul yod de/ nyon mongs rang byung gi ting nge 'dzin/ rnam rtog rang byung gi ting nge 'dzin/ snrel bzhi rang byung gi ting nge 'dzin/ gsal zhing yang la mi rtog pa'i rang byung gi ting nge 'dzin dang bzhi po de la 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /yas bab bzhi 'jog tshul yod de/ dga' ba/ mchog dga'/ dga' bral/ lhan skyes dang bzhi po de la 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /mas stan bzhi 'jog tshul yod de/ mas stan gyi dga' ba/ mchog dga'/ dga' bral/ lhan skyes dang bzhi po de la 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /de rnams la nyams skyon can skyon med gang yin kyang dngos brtags 'byed pa'i tshul yod de/ ngo bo nyid gsum gyi dang po gnyis dang / rang byung bzhi'i dang po gsum la nyams skyon can yin pas khyab cing / de lnga ma gtogs par gyur pa'i gzhan rnams la nyams skyon med kyis khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa ba'i bdun pa grub ste/ de la bum dbang gi grub mtha' 'khor 'das dbyer med/ gsang dbang gi grub mtha' ma 'dres la yongs su rdzogs pa/ sher dbang gi grub mtha' bde stong rgya chung ba/ dbang bzhi pa'i sgrub mtha' bde stong rgya che ba ste bzhir nges pa'i phyir ro/ /brgyad pa grub ste/ bum dbang gi 'da' kha ma de la/ snang ba bsgyur ba'i 'da' kha ma/ sgras 'pho ba'i 'da' kha ma/ 'od kyi gong bu'i 'da' kha ma/ gsang dbang gi 'da' kha ma/ 'od gsal nas 'pho ba'i 'da' kha ma/ sher dbang gi de/ nam 'chi ba'i tshe na rdo rje sems dpa' 'byon par 'gyur ba/ dbang bzhi pa'i 'da' kha ma/ phyag rgya chen po'i lam nas 'pho ba'i 'da' kha ma dang bzhir nges pa'i phyir ro/

/dgu pa grub ste/ bum dbang gi bar do'i gdams ngag snam bya rnam pa lnga po de lha'i rnam par bsgyur te nyams su len pa/ gsang dbang gi snam bya lnga po de yi ge ā l̥ dang kā l̥r bsgyur te nyams su len pa/ sher dbang gi de byang chub kyi sems mu tig gi rdog ma ltar brgyus te nyams su len pa/ dbang bzhi ba'i bar do'i gdams ngag rlung ldang 'jug gnas gsum du nyams su len pa ste bzhir nges pa'i phyir ro/ /bcu pa 'gros bzhi thim tshul la yang bzhir nges pa yin te/ de la rtsa'i 'gros thams cad dbu mar thim pa/ yi ge'i 'gros thams cad yi ge nā dar thim/ khams kyi 'gros thams cad mi shigs pa'i thig ler thim/ rlung gi 'gros thams cad dbu mar thim pa dang bzhir nges ni phyir ro/ /bcu gcig pa gnas gyur 'bras bu la bzhir grangs nges pa yin te/ rtsa gnas gyur pa la sangs rgyas sprul sku/ yi ge gnas gyur pa la sangs rgyas longs sku/ khams gnas gyur pa la sangs rgyas chos sku/ snying po ye shes rlung gnas gyur pa la sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid sku dang bzhir nges pa yin pa'i phyir/ des na bla med sngags sdom de la bskyed rim gyi sdom pa dang rdzogs rim gyi sdom pa gnyis yod kyang / bla med kyi bum dbang rdzogs pa'i tshe/ bla med kyi sngags sdom rdzogs par thob ste/ de'i tshe rigs drug gi sngags sdom rdzogs par thob pa sogs kyis phyir ro/ /des gzhung 'grel zab mo phul du phyin pa bsdus tsam zhig bshad nas// ༈ //gnyis pa dka' gnas kyi mtha' dpyad zab mo bla na med pa 'di nyid bshad na gnyis te/ rjod byed rgyud sde'i rnam gzhag brjod bya sngags lam gyi rnam gzhag go /dang po la bzhi ste/ rgyud sde'i dbye ba/ bsdu ba/ grangs nges/ so sor bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ yo ga pa sangs rgyas gsang ba ni/ de la dbye na gnyis su byed bzhed de/ de la phyi'i de dang / nang gi rgyud sde gnyis su bzhed cing /

de yang / bya spyod gnyis phyi'i de dang / rnal 'byor rgyud dang / rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud gnyis la nang gi rgyud sde zhes sam/ yang na rgyud sde 'og ma gsum phyi'i dang / bla med kyi rgyud la nang gi rgyud sde zhes pa yin no/ /sgrub chen kun snying ni/ rgyud sde la gsum du bzhed de/ bya spyod gnyis/ rnal 'byor rgyud dang gsum du bzhed cing / rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud kyang der ma 'dus pa'i skyon med de/ de rnal 'byor rgyud du 'dus pa'i phyir te/ rnal 'byor rgyud de la ting nge 'dzin sgom tshul gyi sgo nas bla med kyi rgyud kyi khyad par 'byed pa yin pa'i phyir te/ rgyud las/ rnal 'byor spyod dang bya dbye bas/ /rgyud sde gsum du bshad pa yin/ /zhes dang / sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i sngags don rnam gzigs las/ bya dang spyod dang rnal 'byor dang / /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes bzhed pa yin no/ /dpal dges pa rdo rje pa rnams/ rgyud sde la bzhir bzhed pa yin te/ bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dang bzhir bzhed pa'i phyir te/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes bzhed/ pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa ba rnams rgyud sde la lngar bzhed de/ bya spyod gnyis/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi che ba dbyung ba'i phyir rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud ces pa cig dang lngar bzhed do/ /ma rgyud 'khor lo sdom pa ba rnams rgyud sde la drug tu bzhed de/ mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud/ bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud dang drug tu bzhed de/

bde mchog nyung ngu las/ ji srid mdo bya spyod pa dang / /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba las/ /sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa/ /de dang de la dga' ba yin/ /zhes gsung pa'i phyir/ zhes bzhed/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha ni/ rgyud sde la bdun du bzhed de/ sngar gyis drug po'i steng du/ gnyis ka'i rgyud dang bdun du bzhed cing / bdun pa de ni sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi nang mtshan 'ga' zhig dang / pad ma gar gyi rgyud lta bu la 'jog pa yin/ zhes gsung ngo / /gnyis pa bsdu ba la/ shes bya chos can/ rgyud sde'i bsdu tshul yod de/ rgyud sde thams cad bsdus pa de'i tshe na/ bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dang bzhir 'dus pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na rgyud sde la lnga dang / drug dang bdun la sogs par bshad pa'i rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud la sogs pa de rnams bzhi po der ji ltar 'du zhe na/ shes bya chos can/ rgyud sde la lnga ru bzhed pa'i lugs kyi rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud ces pa de/ bzhi po gang rung du ma 'dus pa'i skyon med de/ de 'dra ba de rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud du 'dus pa yin pa'i phyir te/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud de bla med kyi rgyud yin pa gang zhig gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi che ba dbyung ba'i phyir du de la rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud ces bzhag pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dang po de grub ste/ de pha bla na med pa'i rgyud yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang rgyud sde la drug tu bzhed pa'i lugs kyi/ mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud dang / rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud gnyis po de yang / de bzhi po gang rung du ma 'dus pa'i skyon med de/ dang po de bya rgyud du 'du ba yin zhing / phyi ma de bla med kyi rgyud du 'du ba'i phyir ro/ dang po yin te/ spyir bya rgyud de la/ thun mong ba'i dngos grub gtso bor bton pa'i rgyud cig dang /

thun mong ma yin pa'i mchog gi dngos grub gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud cig ste gnyis yod pa las/ dang po de la mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud ces 'jog cing / gnyis pa de la spyi ming bye brag la btags nas bya rgyud ces 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa ba'i rtags phyi ma grub ste/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud ces bshad pa de ni ma rgyud 'khor lo sdom pa'i che ba dbyung ba'i phyir bshad pa yin zhing / ma rgyud 'khor lo sdom pa de nyid bla med kyi rgyud yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyud sde la bdun du bzhed pa'i lugs la yang / bya spyod la sogs pa'i bzhi po gang rung du ma 'dus pa'i skyon med de/ mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud dang / rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud gnyis ni rim bzhin bya rgyud dang bla med kyi rgyud gnyis su bsdu tshul sngar bstan cing / gnyis ka'i rgyud ces pa'i sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i nang tshan 'ga' zhig ni rnal 'byor rgyud du 'du la/ de las gzhan pa 'ga' zhig ni bya spyod gnyis gang rung du 'du ba'i phyir ro/ /rgyud sde la lnga dang drug la sogs par bzhed pa'i rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dang / rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud gnyis po de rim bzhin gsang ba 'dus pa dang / 'khor sdom pa'i che ba dbyung ba'i phyir yin gyi/ don la de gnyis rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud du 'du ba yin no/ /zhes pa de khyod kyis rtog btags sam/ kyogs bshad byas pa ma yin nam zhe na/ de ni ma yin te/ rgyud sde 'ga' zhig las rang rang gi che ba dbyung ba'am che ba brjod pa cung zad gsungs pa'i phyir te/ rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa las/ thams cad rig byed grub mtha' dang / /de bzhin las rgya la sogs pa/ /srid pa dga' 'gyur dngos grub min/ /yang ni srid mthar skye bar 'gyur/ /gang gis mi shes kye rdo rje/ /de yi ngal ba don med yin/ /zhes kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs te lam la 'bad pa byas na/

de don can yin zhing de las gzhan pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang blangs nas 'bad kyang ngal ba don med yin no zhes kye rdo rje che ba brjod pa'i phyir dang / bde mchog las/ rgyud 'di ru ni dbang bskur ba/ /rgyud rnams kun gyi sgo sgrub yin/ /zhes 'khor lo bde mchog gi dbang thob pa de'i tshe na/ rgyud kun 'chad du rung zhing nyan du yang rung ngo / /zhes de'i che ba brjod pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa grangs nges la/ shes bya chos can/ rgyud sde la bya rgyud la sogs pa bzhi po der grangs nges pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ phyi rol pa la log par spyod pa mi 'dra ba bzhi yod/ de rnams rjes su gzung ba'i dbang du byas nas kyang / rgyud sde la bzhir grangs nges/ 'dod pa khams pa la chags pa'i rigs mi 'dra ba bzhi yod/ de rnams lam du bsgyur ba'i dbang du byas nas kyang rgyu sde la bzhir grangs nges/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa la mtshan nyid grub mtha' mi mthun pa bzhi yod/ de dang sgo mthun pa'i dbang du byas nas kyang rgyud sde la bzhir grangs nges/ mi la rigs mi 'dra ba bzhi yod/ de'i dbang du byas nas kyang rgyud sde la bzhir grangs nges/ dus de la rdzogs ldan gyi dus la sogs pa bzhi yod/ de'i dbang du byas nas kyang rgyu sde la bzhir grangs nges/ spyir sems can rnams la nyon mongs pa mi 'dra ba bzhi yod/ de rnams 'dul ba'i dbang du byas nas kyang rgyud sde la bzhir grangs nges pa'i phyir ro/ /dang po yin te/ gti mug can rnams tshangs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas gtsang sbra chos su 'dod pa yod/ de rnams rjes su gzung ba'i phyir du bya rgyud gsungs/ zhe sdang can rnams khyab 'jug gi rjes su 'brangs nas 'tshe ba chos su smra ba yod/ de rnams rjes su gzung ba'i phyir du spyod rgyud gsungs/ 'dod chags can dbang phyug gi rjes su 'brangs nas 'dod chags chos su 'dod pa yod/ de rnams rjes su gzung ba'i phyir du rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud gsungs/

dug gsum ci rigs la spyod pa rnams dug gsum ci rigs pa chos su 'dod pa yod/ de rnams rjes su gzung ba'i phyir du rnal 'byor rgyud gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa de grub pa yin te/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa rnams bltas pa tsam gyis 'khrig pa'i bde ba nyams su myong bar byed/ de lam du bsgyur ba'i dbang du byas nas bya rgyud gsungs/ 'phrul dga' ba rnams rgod pa tsam gyis 'khrig pa'i bde ba nyams su myong bar byed/ de lam du bsgyur ba'i dbang du byas nas spyod rgyud gsungs/ dga' ldan pa dang / 'thab bral ba rnams lag bcangs tsam gyis sgo nas 'khrig pa'i bde ba nyams su myong bar byed/ de rnams lam du bsgyur ba'i dbang du byas nas rnal 'byor rgyud gsungs/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa man chad dbang po nyis sbyor gyi sgo nas 'khrig pa'i bde ba nyams su myong bar byed/ de rnams rjes su bzung ba'i sgo nas bla med kyi rgyud gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa de grub pa yin te/ nyan thos dbang po brtul po nyi 'og bye brag tu smra ba dang / snas ma bu'i sde pa 'ga' zhig rtag mi rtag gang rung brjod du med pa'i bdag khas len/ de dang sgo mthun pa'i dbang du byas nas bya rgyud bzhag nyan thos dbang po 'bring po kha che bye brag tu smra ba dang / mdo sde pa rnams gzung bya phyi don dang / de 'dzin byed kyi shes pa gnyis ka bden grub tu khas len/ de dang sgo mthun pa'i dbang du byas nas spyod rgyud bzhag rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang sems tsam pa rnams bzung bya phyi don bden par ma grub kyang de 'dzin byed kyi shes pa bden grub tu khas len/ de dang sgo mthun pa'i dbang du byas nas rnal 'byor rgyud gsungs/ theg pa chen po sems tsam pa dang dbu ma pa rnams gzung bya phyi don dang / de 'dzin byed kyi shes pa gnyis ka don dam par ma grub kyang / tha snyad kun rdzob tsam du khas len/

de dang sgo mthun pa'i dbang du byas nas rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud bzhag pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na sgo mthun tshul ji ltar yin zhe na/ dang po de yin te/ bya rgyud des kyang sgrub pa po rang nyid kyi mdun du bris sku bkram ste/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa de/ sgrub pa po rang nyid dang bris sku gang rung brjod du med pa de ston pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa de yin te/ des gzung 'dzin de gnyis bden grub tu 'dod pa bzhin te/ spyod rgyud des kyang sgrub pa po rang nyid dang / mdun bskyed gnyis ka lhar bskyed pa'i sgo nas/ lha grogs po lta bu'i tshul gyis dngos grub len pa de ston pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa de yin te/ des de 'dod pa bzhin du/ rnal 'byor rgyud des kyang bdag mdun gnyis ka lhar bskyed/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ de la phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas btab ste/ mthar gshegs gsol byas pa'i sgo nas dngos grub len pa de gtso bor ston pa gang zhig gshegs gsol byed pa dang / gzung bya phyi don ma grub pa mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa yin te/ des de 'dod pa gang zhig bla med 'dis kyang bdag mdun gnyis ka lhar bskyed kyang mthar gshegs gsol mi byed pa'i sgo nas dngos grub len pa de gtso bor ston pa gang zhig gshegs gsol byed pa dang / de gnyis bden med du 'dod pa dang chos mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa de yin te/ bram ze'i rigs rnams gtsang sbra dang dka' spyad la sogs pa drag tu byas pa'i sgo nas grol bar 'dod/ de'i dbang du byas nas bya rgyud gsungs/ rje rigs rnams dka' thub dang / dka' spyad drag tu mi 'dod pa yin pas/ de'i dbang du byas nas spyod rgyud gsungs/ rgyal rigs rnams 'dod yon gyi bde ba la longs spyod par byed/ de'i dbang du byas nas rnal 'byor rgyud gsungs/ dmangs rigs rnams mi gtsang ba la rnam par rtog pa shas chung /

de'i dbang du byas nas bla med kyi rgyud gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa de yin te/ rdzogs ldan gyi dbang du byas nas dang po/ gsum ldan gyi dbang du byas nas gnyis pa/ gnyis ldan gyi dbang du byas nas gsum pa/ rtsod dus kyi dbang du byas nas bzhi pa bla med kyi rgyud bzhag pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ drug pa de yin te/ sems can gti mug can rnams rjes su gzung ba'i phyir du bya rgyud/ zhe sdang can rjes su gzung ba'i ring du spyod rgyud/ 'dod chags can rnams rjes su gzung ba'i phyir bla med kyi rgyud/ dug gsum ci rigs la spyod pa rnams rjes su gzung ba'am 'dul ba'i dbang du byas nas rnal 'byor rgyud rnams gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa so sor bshad pa la/ rgyud sde bzhi so sor bshad pa dang / bla med bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ bla med kyi rgyud bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po la mtshan nyid/ sgra bshad/ dbye ba/ gzhung tshad bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ lha rje dpon lta bu'i tshul gyis dngos grub len pa gtso bor ston pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i cha nas/ rgyud sde rnams kyi dang por bzhag pa de bya rgyud kyi mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa sgra bshad ni/ de la bya rgyud zhes 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ phyi lus ngag gi bya ba gtso bor ston par byed pas na bya rgyud zhes 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa dbye na/ rigs so so'i dbye ba dang / bya ba spyi'i rgyud chen bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la yang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rigs gsum dang / 'jig rten pa'i rigs gsum/ dang po ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi rgyud/ pad+ma'i rigs kyi rgyud/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi rgyud dang gsum yod pa'i/ dang po ni/ dam tshig gsum bkod kyi rgyal po'i rgyud/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo chig sgrub kyi rgyud/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi rgyud/

gtsug tor dri med kyi rgyud rnams la 'jog go /gnyis pa pad+ma'i rigs kyi rgyud ni/ don yod zhags pa'i rgyud/ don yod zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyud/ spyan ras gzigs seng ge sgra'i rgyud/ sgrol ma'i rgyud/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i gzungs la sogs pa rnams la 'jog gsum pa rdo rje'i rigs kyi rgyud ni/ rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud/ phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rgyud/ phyag rdor gtum po'i rgyud/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rgyud la sogs pa rnams la 'jog des na de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob na/ gzhan pad+ma dang rdo rje'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang ma thob kyang de gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bas chog pa yin te/ de gsum gyi nang nas dang po de mchog yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des mtshon nas phyi ma gnyis shes par gyis shig gnyis pa 'jig rten pa'i rigs gsum ni/ nor bu bzang po'i rgyud/ snga tshan gyi rgyud/ 'jig rten pa'i rgyud dang gsum yod pa'i/ dang po ni/ nor bu bzang po'i gzungs lta bu la 'jog gnyis pa ni/ me 'gal la'i gzungs lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ dbugs chen mo'i gzungs lta bu la 'jog go /gnyis pa bya ba spyi'i rgyud chen de la bzhi yod de/ gsang ba spyi rgyud/ dpung bzangs kyi rgyud/ legs grub kyi rgyud/ bsam gtan phyi ma'i rgyud dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir ro/ /kha cig ni/ dam tshig gsum bkod bya ba spyi'i rgyud chen du bsgrong la/ de ni mi 'thad de/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi rgyud yin pas/ de'i rgyud chen du bzhag pa la 'brel med pa'i phyir ro/ /legs grub kyi rgyud bya ba spyi'i rgyud chen du 'jog pa de la/ sdom gsum las/ legs par grub pa yan chad du/ /zhes gsungs pa la dpyad pa byed rgyu yod do/ /des na bya rgyud thams cad bsdus na/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud/

rigs sngags kyi rgyud/ gzungs sngags kyi rgyud dang gsum du 'dus te/ thabs yab gtso bor ston pa'i bya rgyud rnams gsang sngags su 'du/ shes rab ma gtso bor ston pa'i bya rgyud rnams rigs sngags su 'du/ de gnyis ka cha mnyam du gtso bor ston pa'i bya rgyud rnams gzungs sngags su 'du ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa gzhung tshad ni/ bya rgyud de la stong phrag brgyad yod de/ ye shes snying po kun las btus pa las/ rtog pa'i rgyud ni stong phrag bzhi'o/ /bya ba'i rgyud ni stong phrag bzhi'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa spyod rgyud la sngar ltar bzhi las/ dang po ni/ lha grogs po lta bu'i tshul gyis dngos grub len pa gtso bor ston pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i cha nas rgyud sde gnyis par bzhag pa de/ spyod rgyud kyi mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa sgra bshad ni/ nang sems kyi spyod pa dang / phyi lus ngag gi spyod pa gnyis kyi nang nas/ phyi lus ngag gi spyod pa gtso bor ston pas na/ spyod rgyud ces bzhag go /gsum pa dbye na/ sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud gsum mam/ yang na spyod rgyud kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la rgyud la sogs pa gsum yod pa'i/ dang po ni/ rnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud lta bu la 'jog gnyis pa ni/ bod du ma 'gyur bas ngos 'dzin med/ gsum de'i rdo rje'i rigs kyi rgyud ni/ phyag rdor dbang bskur ba'i rgyud lta bu la 'jog 'o na dang po de ston pa gang gis yul gang du gsungs she na/ gsung ba po ni ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i longs sku thub pa rnam snang gangs can 'tsho zhes pa des gsungs shing / yul lam gnas ni gzhi dang snying po me tog gis rgyan pa'i zhing khams der gsungs so/ /'o na de gang la ngos 'dzin zhe na/ de ngos 'dzin tshul yod de/ gling bzhi gling phran brgyad ri rab nyi zla dang bcas pa stong tham pa phyi'i lcags ris bskor ba cig la stong dang po/

de 'dra stong lcags ris bskor ba cig la stong gnyis pa/ de stong lcags ris bskor ba cig la/ stong gsum gyi 'jig rten zhes 'jog cing / de la gling bzhi ri rab la sogs pa bye ba phrag brgya yod la/ de 'dra bye ba phrag brgya la/ gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i rgyud dang po zhes 'jog de bye ba phrag brgya la/ gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i rgyud gnyis pa zhes 'jog de bye ba phrag brgya la gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i rgyud rab 'byams zhes 'jog de 'dra bye ba phrag brgya la/ phyi lcags ris bskor ba mtha'i gsal byed du sbyor cig gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i zhing khams bkod pa de la ngos 'dzin pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa gzhung tshad ni stong phrag brgyad yod de/ ye shes snying po kun las btus pa'i rgyud las/ spyod pa'i rgyud ni stong phrag brgyad/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud la sngar ltar bzhi las/ dang po ni/ bdag mdun gnyis ka lhar bskyed/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ de la phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas btab ste/ mthar gshegs gsol byas pa'i sgo nas dngos grub len pa gtso bor ston pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i cha nas rgyud sde gsum par bzhag pa de rnal 'byor rgyud kyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa sgra bshad ni/ phyi lus ngag dang nang sems gnyis kyi nang nas nang sems kyi rnal 'byor gtso bor bton pas na rnal 'byor rgyud ces bzhag go /gsum pa dbye na/ rtsa rgyud/ bshad rgyud/ cha mthun gyi rgyud dang gsum yod de/ pad+ma myu gu zhes pas mdzad pa'i bstan bcos las/ rtsa rgyud shin tu zab cing rtogs dka'i don/ /bshad dang cha mthun rgyud kyi rnam dbye ba/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang dang po rtsa rgyud ni/ de nyid 'dus pa la 'jog cing / de la yang dum bu bzhi yod de/ dum bu dang po rdo rje dbyings kyi rgyud/

de gnyis pa khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi rgyud/ de gsum pa 'gro 'dul gyi rgyud/ de bzhi pa don grub kyi rgyud dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa bshad rgyud ni/ rgyud rdo rje rtse mo lta bu la 'jog gsum pa cha mthun ni/ ngan song sbyong rgyud lta bu la 'jog go /bzhi pa gzhung tshad ni/ drug brgya yod de/ ye shes snying po kun las btus pa las/ rnal 'byor rgyud ni drug brgya yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud la/ mtshan nyid/ sgra bshad/ dbye ba/ khyad chos dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ dbang bzhi dang / rim gnyis gang rung gtso bor ston pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i cha nas rgyud sde bzhi par bzhag pa de de'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa ni/ ting 'dzin bla na med pa gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud yin pas na/ bla med kyi rgyud ces bzhag go /gsum pa dbye na/ pha bla na med pa'i rgyud/ ma bla na med pa'i rgyud/ gnyis su med pa bla na med pa'i rgyud bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la yang / 'dod chags can rjes su 'dzin pa rnal 'byor gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud/ zhe sdang can rjes su 'dzin pa gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud/ gti mug can rjes su 'dzin pa rnam snang mngon byang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud dang gsum yod de/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gi rgyud sde rnam pa gsum du bshad/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dang po de la yang / rtsa rgyud dang / bshad rgyud gnyis yod pa'i/ dang po ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i le'u bcu bdun pa lta bu la 'jog cing / gnyis pa bshad rgyud de la dbye na/ rdo rje phreng ba'i rgyud/ dgongs pa lung ston pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i zhus rgyud/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ ye shes snying po kun las btus pa'i rgyud dang lnga yod do/ /gnyis pa gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud de la/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud dang / de nag po'i rgyud gnyis yod pa'i/

dang po ni/ gshin rje gshed le'u bcu bdun pa dang / le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa lta bu la 'jog cing / de yang phyi ma de bu ston gyis bsgyur ba yin pas/ de gong bod du mi bzhugs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud de la gsum du yod de/ sgra gdong 'jigs gsum/ zhes gsungs pa ltar gyis/ sgra nag gi rgyud/ gdong drug gi rgyud/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud dang gsum yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa sgyu 'phrul drwa ba la dbye ba med do/ /gnyis pa ma bla na med pa'i rgyud la/ bde mchog ma hā ma ya/ sangs rgyas thod pa dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/ dang po de la yang / rtsa rgyud dang / bshad brgyud gnyis/ dang po la yang / rtsa rgyud rgyas pa dang / bsdus pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bde mchog gi rtsa rgyud rgyas pa 'bum phrag gsum zhes pa de la 'jog cing / de ni rdo rje 'chang gis sngon gyi gdul bya la gsungs shing / deng sang mkha' spyod na bzhugs pa yin gyi/ mi yul na ni mi bzhugs pa yin te/ snyigs dus kyi gdul bya rnams tshe thung bas mi mkho ba la dgongs so/ /gnyis pa de bsdus pa dang / bde mchog nyung ngu zhes pa dang / deng sang gi bde mchog rtsa rgyud ces pa 'di rnams rnam grangs yin no/ /gnyis pa bshad rgyud de la dbye na dgu yod de/ he ru ka mngon byung ngam/ khrag 'thung mngon byung gi rgyud/ bde mchog sdom byung / phag mo mngon byung gi rgyud/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi rgyud/ sam+bu ṭi'i rgyud/ mos spyod bla ma'i rgyud/ a bhi dha na'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ kha sbyor gyi rgyud dang dgu yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa gnyis su med pa bla na med pa'i rgyud la gnyis te/ rgya che ba gnyis su med pa'i de dang / zab pa gnyis su med pa bla na med pa'i rgyud gnyis yod pa'i/ dang po ni/ dus 'khor gyi rgyud lta bu la 'jog la/

de la yang / dus 'khor rtsa rgyud/ de'i rgyud phyi ma dus 'khor bsdus rgyud dang gsum yod do/ /de ltar du yod na/ 'o na dus 'khor gyi rgyud 'di/ yul gang du/ ston pa gang gis/ dus nam gyi tshe gsungs she na/ 'di nyid kyi don la rang lugs bzhag pa dang / gzhan lugs dgag pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ dus 'khor gyi rgyud 'di gsungs tshul yod de/ ston pas dgung lo brgyad cu bzhes pa'i dus na/ dpal 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten du/ byang sham bha la'i rgyal po zla ba bzang po zhes pa lo go dgu lon pa/ rgyal phran go drug dang bcas pas rdzu 'phrul gyis byon te gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa dang / rgyud phyi ma brgya lnga bcu pa 'di gnyis gsungs/ de nas lo drug brgya tsam nas/ rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pas/ me tog phreng 'dzin la sogs pa'i sdeb sbyor gyi sgo nas/ de'i rtsa rgyud dang / rgyud phyi ma gnyis las btus te/ dus 'khor bsdus rgyud zhes pa/ le'u lnga pa sh+lau ka stong sum cu lhag pa 'di gsungs pa yin no/ /le'u lnga ni/ 'jig rten khams le/ nang le/ dbang le/ sgrub thabs kyi le'u/ ye shes kyi le'u dang lnga'o/ /de'i sras rigs ldan pad+ma dkar po'i bsdus rgyud kyi 'grel pa/ 'grel chen dri med 'od mdzad do/ /'ga' zhig bsdus rgyud bka' ma yin no gsung ba yang mi 'thad de/ bsdus rgyud des rtsa rgyud dang / rgyud phyi ma gnyis kyi tshig sna rnams bsdus nas gsungs pa'i phyir dang / 'di nyid byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' ru yang 'gyur ba yin te/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud rang las/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bsdus rgyud la/ /'grel bshad byed pa pad dkar 'dzin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa gzhan lugs dgag pa la/ phyogs snga brjod pa dang / de dgag pa gnyis/ dang po la/ bdag chen rnam rgyal grags pa bzang po la sogs pa kha cig na re/

sa ga zla ba la ston pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan nas de'i phyi lo nag pa zla ba la dus 'khor gyi rgyud gsungs pa yin/ zhes bzhed/ dus zhabs pa sogs kha cig ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa'i phyi lo/ 'khor los bsgyur rgyal gyi tshul du byas nas gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes bzhed do/ /gnyis pa de dgag pa la dang po dgag pa dang / phyi ma dgag pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ rnam rgyal grags bzang gi lugs de 'thad pa ma yin te/ de la dus 'khor rang gi rgyud dang 'gal ba dang / lo rgyus la sogs pa'i 'gal ba'i skyon la sogs pa du ma yod pa'i phyir ro/ /dus 'khor rang dang 'gal ba'i skyon yod de/ de las ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i bka' bar pa sher phyin gyi mdo rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gsungs pa'i rjes nas dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten du dus 'khor gyi rgyud gsungs par bshad pa gang zhig ston pas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan nas/ dang por gtso cher bka' dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos 'khor rnams gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dang po grub ste/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ thub pas bya rgod phung po ru/ /shes rab pha rol phyin tshul bzhin/ /chos bstan dpal ldan 'bras spungs su/ /de bzhin sngags kyi tshul rab gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na lo rgyus sogs dang 'gal ba'i skyon yod na/ lo rgyud ji ltar yin/ de dang 'gal ba'i tshul ji lta bu zhe na/ dang po lo rgyus mtshon tsam brjod na/ ston pa mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan pa'i rjes de nas/ shākya'i tshogs mang po rab tu byung ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs par byas te/ phal che ba rnams kyis 'phags pa thob cing / de rnams ser skya'i grong khyer du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi sras 'phags skyes po dang / de'i blon po gnyis kyis dmag bskul te ser skya'i grong khyer bcom du yong /

de yong ba thos nas shākya'i tshogs de rnams kyis nged rnams rab tu byung ba dang / 'phags pa'i 'bras bu thob pa yin pas/ phar dbyug pa sogs rdeg 'tshog byed pa ma gtogs/ mtshon bsnun pa dang / srog gcod pa la sogs pa gtan nas mi byed do/ /zhes bca' sgrigs byas pa las/ dmag dpung de rnams kyis shākya'i tshogs shin tu mang ba bsad/ de'i tshe shākya sham+bha ka zhes pa'i sprul pa'i gang zag des/ phar 'khrugs te mi mang po bsad/ de nas dmag phyir log zin nas/ shākya'i tshogs lhag ma rnams 'dus nas/ shākya sham+bha ka la khyod kyis bcas pa las 'das pa yin pas/ zhes gnas dbyung byas pas/ shākya sham+bha kas byang sham bha lar byon zhing / de'i sras ni rgyal po zla ba bzang po yin no/ /des na rnam rgyal grags pa bzang po'i lugs de la lo rgyus dang 'gal ba'i skyon yang yod de/ rgyal po zla ba bzang po de'i dgung lo go dgu bzhes pa'i dus su/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po la dus 'khor gyi rgyud zhus pa gang zhig shākya sham+bha ka de rgyal po zla ba bzang po'i yab kyang yin la/ de ni ston pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan pa'i rjes su sham bha lar byon pa'i phyir ro/ /dang po grub ste/ des de zhus te/ des dus 'khor gyi rgyud de byang sham+bha lar gdan yang drangs shing 'grel pa yang brtsams la/ de'i phyi lo des byang sham+bha lar dus 'khor gyis blos blangs kyang bzhengs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa dus zhabs pa'i lugs de yang mi 'thad de/ dus 'khor gyi rgyud zhu ba po rgyal po zla ba bzang po yin pa gang zhig ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul ston pa'i gong du/ rgyal po zla bzang de mi bzhugs pa'i phyir te/ rgyal po zla ba bzang po de ston pa thub pa'i dbang po las lo bcu dgu'i bgres pa gang zhig rgyal po des lo brgya las lhag pa ma bzhugs pa'i phyir te/ rgyal po zla ba bzang po de/ chos rgyal bdun dang /

rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa drug gam/ rtsa lnga la sogs pa 'byung ba'i dang po de yin pa gang zhig rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pa ma gtogs pa'i gzhan phal che ba rnams lo brgya las lhag pa mi bzhugs pa'i phyir ro// ༈ //gnyis pa zab pa gnyis su med pa bla na med pa'i rgyud ni kye rdo rje'i rgyud lta bu la 'jog la/ de la yang / rtsa rgyud/ bshad rgyud/ cha mthun gyi rgyud dang gsum yod pa'i/ dang po la yang / rtsa rgyud rgyas pa'i rgyas pa/ rtsa rgyud rgyas pa/ rtsa rgyud bsdus pa dang gsum yod pa'i dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud 'bum phrag bdun pa zhes pa cig khas blangs dgos pa de la 'jog go /gnyis pa ni/ le'u stong sum cu pa/ brtag pa sum cu so gnyis pa/ sh+lau ka 'bum phrag lnga pa 'di la 'jog pa yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ stong phrag sum cu'i grangs kyi ni/ /'bum phrag lnga yi rgya mtsho che/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ le'u nyer gsum pa/ sh+lau ka bdun brgya nyi shu pa brtag pa gnyis pa 'di la 'jog go /'o na rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa 'di/ rtsa rgyud rgyas pa de las phyung ba yin nam/ rgyud logs pa yin zhe na/ pham thing pa la sogs pa kha cig na re/ 'di logs pa yin te/ de'i rgyud de la brtag pa so gnyis pa/ brtag pa bcu gnyis pa/ brtag pa dgu pa/ brtag pa gnyis pa dang bzhi yod pa'i brtag pa gnyis pa kho yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ mi 'thad de/ brtag pa rang gi mjug tu/ rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu ma'i rgyal po brtag pa so gnyis pa las byung ba zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ nā ro pa'i rjes 'brang dang bcas pa kha cig na re/ brtag pa gnyis pa 'di rgyas pa 'bum phrag lnga las byung ba yin la/ de'i nang nas kyang brtag pa dang po gnyis las phyung ba yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ rdo rje snying po sngon byang chub/ /brtag pa'i rgyal po dang po ste/ sgyu ma'i brtag pa gnyis pa 'o/ /zhes brtag pa so gnyis pa'i brtag pa dang po la mngon par byang chub pa zhes dang /

gnyis pa la sgyu ma'i brtag pa zhes bshad pa gang zhig brtag gnyis 'dir yang brtag pa dang po dang gnyis pa gnyis la/ rim bzhin ming de ltar du bshad pa'i phyir dang / 'dir gleng gzhi yang dang por bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /zhe na de ni mi 'thad de/ brtag gnyis rang gi brtag pa dang po las/ gong du brtag pa bcu gnyis par/ /rgyas par bshad pa mdo ru bsdu/ /zhes dang / gong ma'i rgyud kyi chog rim pas/ /mchod yon zhabs sil gong ma bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / gleng gzhi la yang nges pa med de/ gleng gzhi bar skabs su 'byung ba de 'dra'ang yod pa'i phyir dang / brtag pa'i ming cig pa tsam la'ang nges pa med de/ brtag gnyis 'dir yang / le'u bzhi pa dang / bcu pa gnyis char la dbang le zhes bshad pa gang zhig de gnyis kyang brjod bya'i don so so ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rang gi lugs ni/ rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa 'di/ rtsa rgyud rgyas pa 'bum phrag lnga pa las phyung ba yin cing / de'i nang nas kyang brtag pa so cig pa dang so gnyis pa gnyis las phyung ba yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ rdo rje snying po mngon byang chub/ /brtag pa'i rgyal po dang po ste/ /sgyu ma'i brtag pa gnyis pa 'o/ /zhes pa nas bzung ste/ de ni gsum cu par yang bshad/ /ces brtag pa dang po nas sum cu'i bar bshad nas/ brtag pa so gcig pa dang so gnyis pa gnyis ngos 'dzin pa la/ mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma yi rgyud/ /dag pa'i snying po yongs bsdus pa/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gros gsungs pa ste/ /'di ni rgyud kyi nges pa 'o/ /zhes so gcig pa la mkha' 'gro'i rgyud dang / so gnyis pa la mkha' 'gro ma'i rgyud ces bshad la/ de yang / dang po de rgyal bas rdo rje 'chang gi tshul du byas nas/ gtso bor skyes pa 'dul ba'i phyir du gsungs/ gnyis pa de bdag med mas mkha' 'gro ma'i tshul du byas nas gtso bor bud med 'dul ba'i phyir du gsungs pa gang zhig

brtag pa gnyis pa 'dis kyang / brtag pa dang po de gtso bor skyes pa 'dul ba'i phyir du gsungs la/ gnyis pa de gtso bor bud med 'dul ba'i phyir du gsungs pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ rdo rje gur las/ kye rdo rje yi rnal 'byor rgyud/ /dang po rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs/ /phyi ma rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud/ /de ni bud med gzung phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa bshad rgyud la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud dang / thun mong ba'i bshad rgyud gnyis yod pa'i/ dang po ni/ sh+lau ka stong nyis brgya pa rdo rje gur lta bu la 'jog gnyis pa ni/ sh+lau ka gnyis stong brgyad brgya dang gsum pa/ saṃ pu ṭa'i rgyud lta bu la 'jog 'o na dang po de la thun mong ma yin pa'i de dang / gnyis pa de la thun mong ba'i bshad rgyud ces 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ shes bya chos can/ rdo rje gur de la kye rdo rje'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rdo rje gur des rtsa rgyud rgyas pa brtag pa so gnyis pa dang / bsdus pa brtag pa gnyis pa 'di gnyis kho na'i don gsal bar byed pas na/ de ltar du bzhag pa'i phyir ro/ /sam+bu ṭa'i rgyud de la de'i thun mong ba'i bshad rgyud zhes 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ sam+bu ṭa'i rgyud des/ bod 'dir yang rgyud sde bcu drug gam bcu bdun tsam gyi don gsal bar byed pas na/ de ltar bzhag pa'i phyir dang / rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti la sogs pa rnams ni/ rgyud sde 'bum phrag so drug tsam gyis don gsal bar byed pa yang yin no zhes bzhed do/ /gsum pa cha mthun gyi rgyud ni/ phyag chen thig le'i rgyud/ ye shes thig le'i rgyud/ ye shes snying po'i rgyud dang byas pa rnams la 'jog bzhi pa khyad chos bshad pa la/ pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis med kyi rgyud gsum gyi khyad par bshad pa/ rtsa rgyud dang bshad rgyud gnyis kyi khyad par bshad pa/

rgyu rgyud/ thabs rgyud/ 'bras rgyud gsum gyi khyad par bshad pa dang gsum gyi/ dang po la yang / rjod byed gleng gzhi mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ brjod bya mi 'dra ba'i khyad par zhu ba po'am/ gdul bya mi 'dra ba'i khyad par dang gsum/ dang po la/ de gsum gyi rjod byed gleng gzhi mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod de/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus cig na/ zhes sogs gleng gzhi'i yi ge bzhi bcu'i thog drangs pa'i rgyud rnams la pha rgyud dang / gsang ba mchog gi dges pa na/ /zhes sogs kyi thog drangs pa'i rgyud rnams la ma rgyud dang / de gnyis ka cha mnyam du bzhugs pa'i rgyud rnams la gnyis med kyi rgyud du 'jog pa yin te/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje'i gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsal ba las/ rnal 'byor rgyud du de bzhin gshegs/ /'di skad la sogs gang gsung pa/ /de nyid rnal 'byor ma rgyud du/ /gsang ba mchog gi dges pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid dag tu bzhugs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa brjod bya mi 'dra ba'i khyad par la/ shes bya chos can/ de gsum brjod bya mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod de/ bskyed rim gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud rnams la pha rgyud dang / rdzogs rims gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud rnams la ma rgyud dang / de gnyis cha mnyam du ston pa'i rgyud rnams la gnyis med kyi rgyud du 'jog pa'i phyir te/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsal ba las/ bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i dbye ba las/ /rnal 'byor pha dang rnal 'byor ma/ /bskyed pa rnal 'byor pha zhes brjod/ /rdzogs pa rnal 'byol ma zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / de gsum la bskyed rim ston tshul mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yang yod de/ rags pa phung khams rnams lhar sgom tshul gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud rnams la pha rgyud dang / phra ba rtsa sum cu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa lhar sgom tshul gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud rnams ma rgyud dang /

de gnyis ka cha mnyam du ston pa'i rgyud rnams gnyis med kyi rgyud du 'jog pa'i phyir te/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ mdor na phung po lnga rgyal ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yin/ /zhes dang / bde mchog las/ 'di dag gnas su rnal 'byor ma/ /rtsa gzugs mdzes pa'i yang dag gnas/ /zhes pa dang / brtag gnyis las/ gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te/ /tshor ba la yang dkar mor brjod/ /ces sogs dang / rtsa ni gnyis gnyis rnal 'byor ma/ /re re'i rnam pa rnams su brjod/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de gsum thabs shes ston tshul gyi sgo nas kyang 'jog tshul mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod de/ thabs gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud rnams la pha rgyud dang / shes rab gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud rnams la ma rgyud dang / de gnyis cha mnyam du ston pa'i rgyud rnams gnyis med kyi rgyud du 'jog pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud rgyas pa 'bum phrag lnga pa las/ gang du thabs ni kun ston cing / /shes rab rnam par spyod pas te/ /kun rdzob rnal 'byor pha yi rgyud/ /gang yin de ni ngas bstan to/ /zhes pa dang / gang du shes rab kun ston cing / /thabs ni rnam par spyod pas te/ /kun rdzob rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud/ /gang yin de ni ngas bstan to/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa zhu ba po'am gdul bya mi 'dra ba'i khyad par la/ shes bya chos can/ de gsum gyi zhu ba po'am gdul bya mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod de/ zhu ba po skyes pas byas shing / skyes pa 'dul ba'i phyir du gtso bor gsungs pa'i rgyud rnams la pha rgyud dang / bu med kyis zhus shing / bud med 'dul ba'i phyir du gtso bor gsungs pa'i rgyud rnams la ma rgyud dang / de gnyis ka cha mnyam du bzhugs pa'i rgyud rnams la gnyis med kyi rgyud du 'jog pa'i phyir te/ rdo rje gur las/ skyes pa rnams ni 'dul ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor gyi ni rgyud ces bya/

/btsun mo rnams ni gzung ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor ma ni rgyud ces bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na kye rdo rje'i rgyud gnyis med du khas blangs pa la/ kho na re/ kye rdo rje'i rgyud 'di gnyis med kyi rgyud ma yin par thal/ 'di ma rgyud yin pa'i phyir te/ kye rdo rje'i rgyud las/ rnal 'byor ma rgyud kye rdo rje/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zer na/ gzhung de dang 'gal ba'i skyon med de/ gzhung des kye rdor gyi rgyud kyi shes rab ston tshul bstan pa yin gyi/ ma rgyud du bstan pa ni ma yin pa'i phyir te/ de yin na kye rdor rang dang nang 'gal ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir te/ kye rdor rang las/ thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid rgyud/ /de ni nga yis bshad kyis nyon/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rtsa bshad gnyis kyi khyad par la/ rtsa rgyud dang / bshad rgyud gnyis kyi ngo bo bshad pa dang / bshad rgyud du ji ltar 'gro ba'i tshul bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang gi bshad rgyud rnams kyi dang por byung zhing / bshad pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i rgyud de la/ rtsa rgyud du 'jog la/ de la dbye na/ rtsa rgyud rgyas pa dang / bsdus pa gnyis yod pa'i/ dang po ni/ chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus kyi gdul bya la gsungs pa gtso che la/ phyi ma ni phyis kyi gdul bya rnams la gsungs pa gtso che gsungs kyang brtag par bya'o/ /bshad rgyud ni/ rtsa rgyud kyi phyis 'byung zhing / mched du gyur pa'i rgyud cig la 'jog cing / de la dbye na/ thun mong ba dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud gnyis yod de/ gnyis pa bshad pa la/ don mi gsal ba gsal bar byed pa'i sgo nas bshad rgyud du 'gro ba cig ma tshang ba kha bskang ba'i sgo nas der 'gro ba cig rgyas pa bsdus te ston pa'i sgo nas der 'gro ba cig tshul mi 'dra ba cig bstan pa'i sgo nas der 'gro ba cig cha mthun nges pa bskyed pa'i sgo nas der 'gro ba cig

tshig don rnam par phye ba'i sgo nas bshad rgyud du 'gro ba cig dang drug yod pa'i dang por ni/ rtsa ba'i brtag pa'i rgyud 'dir/ gang zhig dbang gis rab phye bar/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor cho gas sbyin/ /zhes pa dang / zhe sdang rdo rje'i byin brlabs 'dis/ /rigs ni lnga dang drug tu 'gyur/ /zhes dbang gi dbye ba la sogs pa dang / rigs kyi dbye ba mtshon tsam bstan pa rnams/ rdo rje gur du/ dbang gi dbye ba grangs nges la sogs pa rnams dang / rigs kyi dbye bsdu la sogs pa rgyas par bshad pa lta bu la 'jog gnyis pa ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa 'dir/ gsal por mi bzhugs pa rnams/ rdo rje gur dang / sam+bu ṭa'i rgyud gnyis nas/ kha bskang nas bshad pa lta bu la 'jog gsum pa ni/ rtsa ba'i brtag pa'i rgyud 'dir spyod pa'i rnam par bzhag pa rgyas par bshad pa de/ rdo rje gur du bsdus te bshad pa lta bu la 'jog bzhi pa ni/ rtsa ba'i brtag pa'i rgyud 'dir/ gau rī la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad kyi sngags dang phyag rgya la sogs bshad pa de dang / rdo rje gur las/ de dang cung mi 'dra bar bshad pa lta bu la 'jog lnga pa ni/ rtsa ba'i brtag pa'i rgyud 'dir bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i sku mdog dang / phyag mtshan bstan pa ji lta bar rdo rje gur las kyang de ltar du bstan pa lta bu la 'jog drug pa ni/ rtsa ba'i brtag pa gnyis pa'i rgyud 'dir/ rtsa rnams ni sum cu rtsa gnyis te/ mi phyed ma dang / zhes mdor bstan pa tsam zhig gsungs pa de/ sam+bu ṭa las/ rtsa'i ngo bo gnas tshul/ byed pa/ de la brten nas sa dang po rab tu dga' ba la sogs pa thob tshul rgyas par bshad pa lta bu la 'jog go /gsum pa rgyu rgyud/ thabs rgyud/ 'bras rgyud gsum gyi khyad par bshad pa la/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ rgyud ni rgyun chags zhes bya ste/ /rgyud de rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /gzhi dang de yi rang bzhin dang /

/mi 'phrog pa yi rab phye ba'o/ /rang bzhin rnam pa rgyu yin te/ /gzhi ni thabs zhes bya bar brjod/ /de bzhin mi 'phrogs 'bras bu ste/ /rgyud de rnam pa gsum du 'du/ /zhes rgyu rgyud la sogs pa gsum bshad cing / de gsum ngos 'dzin pa la/ 'khrul pa'i dri ma thams cad zad pa'i rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal nas/ rang sems gdod nas spros bral rgyu rgyud dang / /dbang gi ye shes lam gyi lta ba dang / /nyams myong sangs rgyas sa dang ngo bo cig /rtogs pa'i khyad par zla ba'i dpe yis bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi/ dang po rgyu rgyud ni/ spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral zhing / gsal stong zung du chud pa'i rang rgyud kyi sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba 'di la 'jog go /'o na de la rgyu rgyud ces 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan ji ltar yin zhe na/ de la rgyu rgyud ces 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rkyen dang 'phrad na nus pa bskyed pas na rgyu/ de rgyun mi 'chad pas na rgyud/ ces 'jog pa yin pa'i phyir/ brtag gnyis las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs/ /de nyid gsal na sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces pa dang / sam+bu ṭa las/ nam mkha' ji srid mi 'jig pa/ /nam mkha' ji srid sems de srid/ /ces sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa thabs rgyud ni/ dbang bzhi bskur ba'i dus su skyes pa'i ye shes rnams dang / lam bzhi bsgom pa las byung ba'i lta ba rnams dang / nyams myong sa bcu gsum pa'i phyed 'og ma man chad kyi mtshon bya don gyi ye shes rnams la 'jog go /de rnams la thabs rgyud ces 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yang yod de/ rgyu rgyud la gnas pa'i nus pa de/ ma smin pa smin par byed pa dang / smin pa gong du 'phel bar byed pa chu lud lta bu'i rkyen byed pas na thabs/ de rgyun mi 'chad pas na rgyud/ ces 'jog pa'i phyir te/ sam+bu ṭa las/

bstan bcos tshad ma slob dpon dang / /lung gi rjes 'brangs de nyid rig /gsang don de nyid dngos po ni/ /gcig nas gcig brgyud shes par bya/ /bla ma rab kyi zhal las blang / /zhes pa dang / brtag gnyis las/ chu bo'i rgyun ni rab 'bab dang / /mar me'i rtse mo rab bcings ltar/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa 'bras rgyud ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sku lnga dang / ye shes lnga la sogs pa la 'jog cing / de la 'bras rgyud ces 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yang yod de/ rgyu rgyud la gnas pa'i nus pa de/ thabs rgyud kyis smin pa dang gong du 'phel ba la sogs pa'i 'bras bu lo tog lta bu yin pas na/ 'bras bu de rgyun mi 'chad pas na rgyud ces bzhag pa yin pa'i phyir/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rang bzhin dang ni rgyun mi 'chad/ /rgyun gyi de dag rtag pa nyid/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar rgyu rgyud sogs gsum gyi rnam gzhag spyir bstan nas/ de gsum dges pa rdo rje la yang sbyor tshul bshad na/ kye rdo rje la yang 'bras bu'i kye rdo rje sogs sbyor tshul yod de/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po dang / shes rab chen po zung du chug pa mthar thug pa cig la 'bras bu'i kye rdo rje zhes dang / 'bras bu de thob par byed pa'i lam de la thabs lam gyi kye rdo rje zhes dang / de thob par byed pa'i rgyu de la/ rgyu'i kye rdo rje zhes dang / de rnams brjod byar ston pa'i bka' dang bstan bcos rnams la/ gzhung gi kye rdo rje zhes 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /des na de rnams kyi nang nas/ 'bras bu'i kye rdo rje de kye rdo rje mtshan nyid pa yin zhing / gzhan rnams de btags pa ba yin te/ rje btsun bsod rtse'i rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag las/ de bas na sangs rgyas kyis dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang / shes rab chen po zung du chud pa kye rdo rje 'bras bu'i rgyud yin la/

'bras bu'i rgyud de thob par byed pa'i thabs dang / rgyu la yang / kye rdo rje'i ming gis btags pa yin te/ dper na/ phyogs kyi glang pos/ shes rab pha rol phyin gnyis med/ /ye shes de ni de bzhin gshegs/ /sgrub bya de don sbyor ba yis/ /gzhung lam dag la de sgras btags/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa brjod bya sngags lam gyi rnam gzhag la bzhi ste/ bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud kyi sngags lam gyi rnam gzhag go /dang po la bya rgyud kyi dbang gi rnam gzhag dngos dang / de la brten pa'i grol byed lam gyi rnam gzhag gnyis yod pa'i/ dang po la drug ste/ gang gis bskur ba'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi rnam gzhag gang la bskur ba'i slob ma'i rnam gzhag gang du bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam gzhag ji ltar bskur ba'i cho ga'i rnam gzhag gang bskur ba'i dbang gi rnam gzhag de ltar bskur ba la brten nas bya rgyud kyi sdom pa'i rnam gzhag go /dang po la spyir btang / khyad chos lnga dang ldan pa cig dgos te/ bya rgyud kyi dbang rdzogs par thob pa yin pa/ de'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa yin pa/ de'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga la mkhas pa yin pa/ rten slob ma la phyi nang gi rten 'brel sgrig mkhyen pa yin pa/ slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la sku gsung thugs kyi sa bon thebs par nus pa dang bcas pa'i lnga po de dang ldan pa cig dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /dmigs bsal bya rgyud kyi dbang bskur ba la bya rgyud kyi dbang thob pa cig mi dgos te/ bla med kyi dbang thob pa zhig gis bya spyod gnyis kyi dbang bskur du rung ba yin pa'i phyir te/ rje btsun bsod rtse'i dbang bcu las/ dbang bskur ba drug po 'di dag thob pas ni rtog pa dang dpyod pa dang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud mtha' dag nyan du rung la/ rnal 'byor rgyud bshad du mi rung yang /

bya spyod gnyis bshad du rung ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa de la khyad chos gnyis dang ldan pa cig dgos te/ bya rgyud kyi lha dang bla ma la dad gus yod pa/ de'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrung nus pa ste/ de yang gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar la'ang yin pa gcig dgos pa'i phyir te/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ mkhas pa slob ma gcig gam gsum/ /lnga 'am yang na bdun dag gam/ /nyi shu rtsa ni lnga yi bar/ /zung du ma gyur slob ma gzung / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa gang du bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor de la drug tu yod de/ ye shes kyi/ sprul pa'i/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rdul tshon gyi/ ras bris/ lus dkyil sogs drug tu yod cing / ngos 'dzin 'og tu 'byung ngo / /bzhi pa ji ltar bskur ba'i cho ga 'jog tshul yod de/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ rnam dpyad dang po sa gzhi gzung / /gnyis pa sta gon gnas pa ste/ /gsum pa la ni 'jug pa shis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi/ nub dang po la sa'i cho ga /gnyis pa la sta gon gyi cho ga gsum pa la dngos gzhi'i cho ga dang gsum po de la 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa gang bskur ba'i dbang de la/ sgras brjod rigs kyi sgo nas phye na bzhi yod de/ slob dpon du byed pa'i dbang / rig sngags bzlas lung du byed pa'i dbang / byab bkru bsrung gsum gyi dbang / bkra shis rdzas brgyad pa'i dbang bzhi yod pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhi la dngos brtags 'byed pa'i tshul yang yod de/ dang po de smin byed kyi dbang mtshan nyid pa yin la/ phyi ma gsum po de de ltar btags pa yin pa'i phyir te/ mtha' rten gyi dbang yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de skad du yang / gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ dbang bskur ba ni rnam pa bzhi/ /slob dpon go 'phang rab sgrub phyir/ /dang po yongs su bsgrags pa yin/ /rig sngags rab tu sgrub pa yis/ /gnyis pa legs par bshad pa yin/

/bgegs rnams gzhom par bya ba'i phyir/ /gsum pa rab tu bsgrags pa yin/ /bzhi pa 'byor pa thob pa'i phyir/ /cho ga rgyas pa 'di bshad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang bya rgyud kyi dbang de chos can/ khyod la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na gnyis su yod de/ chu'i dbang dang / cod pan gyi dbang gnyis yod pa'i phyir te/ ye shes thig le'i rgyud las/ chu yi dbang bskur cod pan dag /bya ba'i rgyud la rab tu grags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de chos can/ khyod la rigs kyi sgo nas phye na gsum du yod de/ bya rgyud de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor du bskur ba'i dbang / de'i pad+ma'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor du bskur ba'i dbang / de'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du bskur ba'i dbang dang gsum yod pa'i phyir ro/ /drug pa de'i sdom pa'i rnam gzhag 'chad pa la/ bya rgyud rang rkang la/ skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa tsam zhig bshad pa yin gyi/ de las gzhan rigs lnga'i sdom gzung dang / rigs lnga'i sdom pa ni ma bshad de/ skabs der rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang dang / de slob ma'i dbang gi tha snyad ma bshad pa'i phyir dang / sangs rgyas rnams rigs lngar bsdu tshul ma bshad pa'i phyir dang / bya rgyud kyi lha rnams rigs lngar bsdu tshul ma bshad pa'i phyir dang / bya spyod gnyis kyi rgyud du yang / /sangs rgyas rigs lngar bsdus pa med/ /spyod rgyud la ni rigs lnga yi/ /don grub na yang tha snyad med/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bya rgyud kyi sdom pa thob tshul de la lnga yod de/ sta gon gyi rgyun bshags kyi skabs su thob pa'i sdom pa cig phyi nang gi sems dpa'iྎ ye shes dbab pa'iྎ rig sngags bzlas lung giྎ chu'i dbang bskur gyiྎ cod pan gyi dbang bskur gyi skabs su thob pa'i sdom pa dang lnga yod pa'i phyir ro/ /bya rgyud kyi sdom pa de rdzogs par thob pa'i dus kyang yod pa yin te/

chu dang cod pan gyi dbang bskur rdzogs par thob pa'i tshe na de rdzogs par thob pa yin te/ de gnyis rdzogs pa dang / de'i dbang gi dngos gzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na bya rgyud la sngags sdom med dam mnyam na/ bya spyod gnyis la rigs lnga'i sngags sdom med kyang / spyir sngags sdom yod pa yin te/ bya spyod kyi skyabs sems kyi sdom pa de sngags sdom yin pa'i phyir/ 'di'i gnad go dgos so/ /gnyis pa grol byed lam bstan pa la gnyis te/ mtshan bcas dang / mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po ni/ rang nyid tha mal du byas/ mdun du bris sku bkram/ de la ye shes pa bskyed de/ rje dpon gyi tshul du dngos grub len pa de la/ mtshan bcas kyi rnal 'byor zhes 'jog pa yin te/ sdom gsum rab dbye las/ 'on kyang bya ba'i rgyud du ni/ /bris sku lha ru sgom nas kyang / /de la dngos grub len pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa mtshan bcas kyi de la gsum yod de/ mer gnas kyi rnal 'byor/ sgrar gnas kyi rnal 'byor/ sgra mthar thar pa ster ba'i rnal 'byor dang gsum yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa spyod rgyud kyi de 'chad pa la gnyis te/ de'i dbang bshad pa dang / de la brten pa'i lam gyi rnam gzhag go /dang po la gang gis dbang bskur ba'i rdo rje slob dpon la sogs pa lnga yod pa'i/ dang po de la spyod rgyud kyi dbang rdzogs par thob pa la sogs pa'i khyad chos lnga dang ldan pa cig dgos pa gong dang 'dra zhing / nges par de'i dbang thob dgos pa ni ma yin te/ bla med kyi dbang thob pa zhig gis bya spyod gnyis kyi dbang ma thob kyang / de'i dbang bskur chog pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa gang la bskur ba'i slob ma de la khyad chos gnyis dang ldan pa cig dgos te/ spyod rgyud kyi lha dang bla ma la dad gus yod pa/ de'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrung nus pa dang bcas pa'i khyad chos gnyis dang ldan pa cig dgos pa'i phyir ro/

/de yang slob dpon du 'os pa'i dbang de la slob ma'i grangs nges gcig nas bcu'i bar ci rigs pas chog gis/ grangs kha yar ba dgos pa'i nges pa med de/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ dpal la yi rab brtan pa ni/ /bcu 'am brgyad dam bdun nam lnga/ /gcig gnyis bzhi las lhag kyang rung / /dpyad mi dgos pas gzung bar bya/ /zhes dang / de'i tshig lhug pa las/ gsang ba'i bdag po sngon theg pa chen po'i spyod pa'i sgo mtha' yas pa sgrub pa la goms pa de dag ni rdo rje sems dpa' yin te/ de rnams nyid kyi don gyi phyir grangs kyi tshad 'di byas so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /spyod rgyud kyi slob mar 'os pa'i dbang de la/ slob ma'i grangs nges yod pa ma yin te/ de nyid las/ 'on kyang slob dpon snying rje chen po dang ldan pas sems can gyi khams ma lus par bsgral bar yid dam bcas pa kho nar byas te/ des byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir/ sems can tshad med pa rnams yongs su gzung bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa gang du bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / bzhi pa ji ltar bskur ba'i cho ga gnyis gong dang 'dra la/ lnga pa gang la bskur ba'i dbang de la lngar yod de/ chu/ cod pan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ ming gi dbang dang lnga yod pa'i phyir te/ ye shes thig le'i rgyud las/ chu'i dbang bskur cod pan dang / /rdo rje dril bu ming gi dbang / /spyod pa'i rgyud du gsal bar phye/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /drug pa de la brten nas thob pa'i sdom pa de la lnga ru yod de/ sta gon nam rgyun bshags kyi skabs su thob pa'i sngags sdom nas/ rig sngags bzlas lung gi bar gyi sngags sdom lnga yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa grol byed kyi lam la mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor gnyis yod pa'i/ dang po mtshan bcas kyi rnal 'byor 'jog tshul yod de/ rang nyid lhar bskyed mdun du ras bris bkram/
